method: Direct native vision inspection of rasterized PDF pages; automated checks separately recorded.
coverage: All 15 pages inspected in the build loop; final changes were limited to diagram paragraph boundary and incoming-value term J, and all affected pages were inspected again.

findings.diagram: Cue within RGB image, dashed external task-name routing only to head, three distinct KDA state loops and final ConvGRU loop are visible.
findings.math: Inspected KDA shapes, exact toy fractions/matrices, expanded transition, S0/S1/S2 unrolling, transport order and transposed coefficients, optional norm proof, ConvGRU interpolation. No collisions or clipping observed.
findings.tables: Notation, encoder, state sizes, parameters, task labels, rationale and source map are legible.
findings.fixes: Resolved initial TeX line-break escape; tightened sensory prose to eliminate a spillover page without deleting the takeaway; fixed figure splitting cue paragraph; avoided B batch/write name collision with J.
findings.limit: Human-readable organization was revised throughout; length or automated bounds alone are not a readability guarantee.
